questions.question_english: Section 43 of the POCSO Act places an obligation on the Central and State Governments to take measures for which of the following?
options_english: Constructing exclusive separate schools for child abuse victims nationwide
Creating widespread awareness and training concerned officers
Providing monetary compensation directly from the Prime Minister’s Relief Fund
Deporting foreign nationals accused of child abuse under immigration laws
questions.explanation_english: Creating widespread awareness and training concerned officers. Section 43 mandates Central and State Governments to take comprehensive measures to give wide publicity to statutory provisions through media and educate the public, children, parents, and officials. Periodic training ensures sensitizing police, healthcare workers, and judicial officers regarding their legal child protection duties and procedural responsibilities.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। संबंधित अधिकारियों के लिए व्यापक जागरूकता और प्रशिक्षण का निर्माण। धारा 43 केंद्र और राज्य सरकारों को मीडिया के माध्यम से वैधानिक प्रावधानों को व्यापक रूप से प्रचारित करने और जनता, बच्चों, माता-पिता और अधिकारियों को शिक्षित करने के लिए व्यापक उपाय करने का दायित्व देती है। समय-समय पर प्रशिक्षण यह सुनिश्चित करता है कि पुलिस, स्वास्थ्य कर्मियों और न्यायिक अधिकारियों को उनके कानूनी बाल संरक्षण कर्तव्यों और प्रक्रियात्मक जिम्मेदारियों के प्रति संवेदनशील बनाया जाए।
key_facts: Section 43 mandates awareness and training measures.
Governments must educate public and officials.
Printed answer key: (B) Creating widespread awareness and training concerned officers.

questions.question_english: Which of the following is a mandatory administrative measure for schools prescribed by CBSE and DoE guidelines to ensure child safety in relation to the POCSO Act?
options_english: Mandatory polygraph lie-detector tests for all male teachers annually
Police verification and psychometric evaluation of staff
Banning all male teachers from instructing female students in class
Allowing parents unrestricted access to classrooms during working hours
questions.explanation_english: Police verification and psychometric evaluation of staff. Educational boards and regulatory bodies mandate thorough background checks, including mandatory police verification and psychometric evaluation, for all teaching and non-teaching school staff prior to employment. These preventative administrative safeguards ensure a secure institutional environment and minimize potential child safety risks across all school activities and campus areas.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। कर्मचारियों की पुलिस सत्यापन और मनोवैज्ञानिक मूल्यांकन। शैक्षणिक बोर्डों और नियामक निकायों द्वारा सभी शिक्षण और गैर-शिक्षण स्कूल कर्मचारियों के लिए रोजगार से पहले गहन पृष्ठभूमि जांच, जिसमें अनिवार्य पुलिस सत्यापन और मनोवैज्ञानिक मूल्यांकन शामिल हैं, अनिवार्य किया गया है। ये निवारक प्रशासनिक सुरक्षा उपाय एक सुरक्षित संस्थागत वातावरण सुनिश्चित करते हैं और सभी स्कूल गतिविधियों और परिसर क्षेत्रों में संभावित बाल सुरक्षा जोखिमों को कम करते हैं।
key_facts: POCSO Act mandates police verification for staff.
Psychometric evaluations are essential for child safety.
Printed answer key: (B) Police verification and psychometric evaluation of staff.

questions.explanation_english: Section 33(2) mandates that the Special Court shall permit cross-examination of the child victim by defense counsel by putting questions to the judge, who then puts them to the child.
